notes: s008 ἡ takes the supplied determiner together with the supplied nominal 'mother' and heads on the nominal under rule 102; rule 52's reading, which gives the whole relational expression to the genitive name, is the competing analysis and is named in the unit note. It is scoped to a bare genitive with no article, whereas an article stands here — MRK.15.40, where μήτηρ is expressed, is analysed compatibly.
